title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hook + metrics export for regression gating
author: Elena Park
commits: a9f3b2c: add new per-prompt CI hook that runs eval-harness per-prompt cohorts; b4d7e11: emit per-prompt metrics to telemetry/metrics exporter; c2a9d90: sampling strategy for large prompt-sets to bound CI runtime; d8f7c33: add docs and examples; e1123ef: fix flaky eval runner timeout handling
description: Motivation: run lightweight, per-prompt regression checks in CI so model and infra changes surface prompt-level quality regressions earlier. This PR adds a new eval-harness CI hook that runs a sampled subset of prompt-sets and exports per-prompt metrics (accuracy, BLEU-like scores, n-gram overlap, and model-confidence deltas) to the metrics pipeline for gating and dashboarding. Changes: 1) CI hook: .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml that orchestrates jobs and parallelizes cohorts; 2) Eval runner: eval-harness/ci_runner.py adds sampling, retry/backoff, and KV-cache warm-start support; 3) Metrics exporter: telemetry/metrics_exporter.py emits histogram and taggable counters per-prompt_id and model_version; 4) Config: eval-harness/configs/per_prompt_ci.yaml with sensible defaults and overrides for Dedicated/Private runs; 5) Docs: docs/ci/per-prompt-ci.md with rollout and troubleshooting. Testing: added unit tests and a small integration matrix that ran on a dedicated CI worker pool. Rollout plan: beta enabled for canary pipelines for 2 weeks, then gradually enable on all PRs under 50 changed files; full enable controlled by feature flag. Backwards compatibility: hook is opt-in and defaults to sample size 25 to avoid CI runtime blow-up. Impact: improves early detection of regressions tied to prompt subsets and provides telemetry to feed eval dashboards and alerting.
files_changed: .github/workflows/eval-per-prompt.yml; eval-harness/ci_runner.py; eval-harness/configs/per_prompt_ci.yaml; telemetry/metrics_exporter.py; tests/ci/test_per_prompt_ci.py; docs/ci/per-prompt-ci.md; examples/ci/sample_prompt_set.json; tools/ci/sampling_util.py; Makefile (ci targets)
review_thread:
Samir: 'This looks great, but CI runtime could be problematic on large prompt-sets — can we reduce default sample size and add a fast-fail mode?'
Elena: 'Agreed, default sample size reduced to 25 and added fast-fail via --fail-fast flag; also added explicit sampling strategy doc.'
Jordan: 'Can you add tags so metrics can be sliced by model family and deployment type?'
Elena: 'Added model_family and deployment_type tags to metrics_exporter; updated tests.'
Ava: 'Approved after unit tests and integration evals passed on dedicated worker pool.'
release_notes: Adds per-prompt CI hook and metrics exporter for eval-harness. Opt-in sampling defaults to 25 prompts. Exposes per-prompt metrics for regression gating and dashboards.
